blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. Today's lesson is short and practical. You can use these words with the finance team.

Today you learn five useful words: today, now, current, final, and open. You practise them in short, simple sentences. Go slowly — one step at a time.

Good numbers are clear and honest. Sophie helps new trainees every day. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is the language of Czarnikow's numbers?
items.why: "Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "You learn five useful words: today, now, current, final, and open."

items.q: Good numbers are…
items.why: "Good numbers are clear and honest."

items.q: "Go slowly — one step at a time." This suggests the lesson is…
options: easy to learn if you take your time
items.why: Inferência: a frase encoraja calma — a lição é acessível passo a passo.

items.q: "You can do it!" tells us the writer wants to…
items.why: Inferência: o tom é de incentivo, não de aviso ou correção.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentando o tema para um novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the accounting team. I am Sophie. Today we talk about "Today's Numbers". It is easy. Do not worry.

First, listen to five words. Today. Now. Current. Final. Open. Say them with me. Good!

Look at this sheet. The current report is on the desk. It is ready now. The final numbers are here too. They are correct.

Is the file open? Yes, it is open. Please check today's numbers with me. We work slowly. One step at a time.

You are new, but you are doing well. Numbers are clear and honest. That is our job. You can ask me questions. I am happy to help.

Great work today. See you tomorrow!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "I am Sophie."

items.q: What are the five words?
items.why: "Today. Now. Current. Final. Open."

items.q: Is the file open?
items.why: "Is the file open? Yes, it is open."

items.q: Sophie says "We work slowly. One step at a time." This suggests she wants the trainee to feel…
items.why: Inferência: ela repete que o trabalho é devagar para deixar o trainee tranquilo.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the new trainee?
items.why: Inferência: "you are doing well", "I am happy to help" — tom positivo e de apoio.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please send the report today." Today means…
items.why: Today = hoje, este dia.

items.q: "I am busy now." Now means…
items.why: Now = agora, neste momento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This is the ___ report — it has this week's numbers."
items.why: Current = atual; o relatório com os números desta semana.

items.q: "These are the final numbers." Final means…
items.why: Final = final, os números prontos e definitivos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The file is ___, so you can read it now."
items.why: Open = aberto; o arquivo está aberto para leitura.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you fill in this form?" To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever as informações.

items.q: "Please check the numbers." To check means to…
options: look and make sure they are right
items.why: Check = verificar, conferir se está certo.

items.q: "Let's go over the report together." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, passar por algo juntos.

items.q: "I will hand in the report today." To hand in means to…
items.why: Hand in = entregar (a alguém, como o chefe).

items.q: "Take your time and carry on." To carry on means to…
items.why: Carry on = continuar, seguir em frente.
